description: This file defines a SlackClient class that provides a wrapper around the slack_sdk.WebClient to perform common Slack operations such as validating channels, fetching recent messages, resolving user names, and constructing thread URLs.

classes.name: SlackClient
classes.description: A wrapper class for the Slack SDK WebClient that encapsulates operations like channel validation, message fetching, user resolution, and URL building.

methods.name: __init__(self, bot_token: str)
methods.description: Initializes the SlackClient with a bot token, raising an error if no token is provided.

methods.name: bool validate_channel(self, channel_id: str)
methods.description: Checks if a specified Slack channel exists and is accessible.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] fetch_recent_messages(self, channel_id: str, limit: int = 200)
methods.description: Retrieves recent messages from a specified Slack channel, up to a limit (default 200).

methods.name: str resolve_user(self, user_id: Optional[str])
methods.description: Resolves a Slack user ID to a display name or username, fallback to user ID if resolution fails.

methods.name: str build_thread_url(self, channel_id: str, ts: Optional[str])
methods.description: Constructs a permalink URL for a Slack message thread based on channel ID and timestamp.

ctags.name: build_thread_url
ctags.pattern: /^    def build_thread_url(self, channel_id: str, ts: Optional[str]) -> str:$/

ctags.name: fetch_recent_messages
ctags.pattern: /^    def fetch_recent_messages(self, channel_id: str, limit: int = 200) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:$/
